newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp says STAR losses as expected.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp says STAR losses as expected.

text.p: The News Corporation Ltd said on Tuesday that losses in the three months to September from its Asian satellite broadcaster, STAR TV, continued to remain in line with expectations.
The company said STAR's total revenue grew by 16 percent in the quarter, with growth occurring in both advertising and subscrition revenues.
Also during the quarter, STAR formed a sports programming joint venture with Walt Disney Co's sports channel ESPN to develop sports programming opportunities across the region, News Corp said.
"Both existing STAR Sports and ESPN-Asia brands will be preserved as the new company aims to provide multiple sports programming services," News Corp said.
News Corp said its 40 percent owned U.K. satellite broadcaster, BSkyB reported continued strong growth, with after tax profits surging 30 percent to 66 million pounds sterling in the quarter.
"Total subscribers now stand at 5.65 million, with growth from both continuing dish sales and increased cable connections," the company said.
News Corp earlier announced that its first quarter net profit had slipped to A$283 million from A$308 million in the previous corresponding quarter.
